About.metaDescription: 237Logement was born from a simple observation: finding a reliable home in Cameroon used to be a real ordeal. Discover our mission.
About.paragraph1: 237Logement was born from a simple observation: finding a reliable home in Cameroon used to be a real ordeal. Scams, abusive middlemen, outdated listings... Millions of Cameroonians were losing time and money in this real estate jungle.
About.paragraph2: Our mission: build Cameroon's first trusted real estate platform, where tenants and owners can meet directly, with full transparency and no excessive fees.
About.value1Desc: All our owners are verified. Every listing is checked before publishing to guarantee the accuracy of the information.
About.value2Desc: We believe every Cameroonian deserves a decent home. Our platform is free for tenants and accessible everywhere in Cameroon.
About.value3Desc: No hidden fees, no surprise commission. Displayed prices are accurate and contact happens directly between the parties.
About.value4Desc: We keep investing in technology to deliver the best experience: smart search, interactive map, real-time notifications.
About.missionParagraph1: We work closely with local authorities and owner associations to improve Cameroon's rental market and make it fairer for everyone.
About.missionParagraph2: Our goal for 2026: cover all 10 regions of Cameroon and become the go-to reference for real estate in Central Africa.

HowItWorks.metaDescription: 237Logement simplifies real estate rentals in Cameroon. Whether you're a tenant or an owner, discover how to make the most of our platform.
HowItWorks.subtitle: 237Logement simplifies real estate rentals in Cameroon. Whether you're a tenant or an owner, here's how to make the most of our platform.
HowItWorks.step1Text: Our advanced search engine lets you filter by city, neighborhood, rental type (short or long-term), budget, number of bedrooms and amenities. Refine your search until you find exactly what you need. View results at the same time on the interactive map of Cameroon.
HowItWorks.step2Text: Every listing has a high-resolution photo gallery, a full description, an inventory of amenities, a map location and the owner's verified profile with their reviews. Save your favorites to compare them at your leisure.
HowItWorks.step3Text: Send a message or call the owner directly from the listing page. No agency fees, no hidden middleman. Owners receive your requests in their dashboard and can reply quickly. Negotiation happens freely between you.
HowItWorks.step4Title: Manage your listings like a pro
HowItWorks.step4Text: Owners get a full dashboard: 5-step publishing, listing management, stats tracking (views, contacts, favorites), built-in messaging. Edit or delete your listings anytime. Get alerts for every new message or interest.

FaqItems.q1Q: Is creating an account free on 237Logement?
FaqItems.q1A: Yes, creating an account is entirely free, whether you're a tenant or an owner. Tenants access every feature (search, favorites, alerts, contacting owners) at no cost. Owners can publish listings and manage their properties with no commission or mandatory subscription.
FaqItems.q2Q: How do I search for a home that fits my needs?
FaqItems.q2A: Use the main search bar and our advanced filters: select your city (Yaoundé, Douala, Bafoussam…), your neighborhood, the rental type (short or long-term), your maximum budget and the desired number of bedrooms. Each listing then shows its precise location so you can identify properties in your preferred area.
FaqItems.q3Q: How do I publish a listing for my property?
FaqItems.q3A: It's simple! Create an Owner account, then click "Publish a listing". Our 5-step form guides you: location, property details (bedrooms, surface, amenities), photos, pricing and final preview. Your listing is checked by our team within 24 hours, then published automatically. You can edit or delete your listing anytime from your dashboard.
FaqItems.q4Q: Are there agency fees to pay?
FaqItems.q4A: No, 237Logement charges no agency fees on transactions between tenants and owners. Our model is based on direct, transparent connections. You negotiate the rental terms directly with the owner: rent, deposit, charges, duration. No middleman gets between you.
FaqItems.q5Q: How are owners verified on the platform?
FaqItems.q5A: Our team verifies each owner's identity before granting the "Verified" badge: national ID check, phone number confirmation and proof of property ownership (land title or lease contract). Verified owners display a gold badge on their listings. We recommend favoring these listings for extra security.
FaqItems.q6Q: Can I rent a home for a short stay (weekend, vacation)?
FaqItems.q6A: Absolutely! 237Logement offers two rental types: long-term (classic monthly rental) and short-term (by the night or week). Use the "Rental type" filter in search to show only short-stay offers. These homes are often furnished and equipped, ideal for business travelers or vacationers.
FaqItems.q7Q: How do I save listings I'm interested in?
FaqItems.q7A: Click the ❤️ heart on any listing (in search results or on the detail page) to add it to your favorites. Your favorites are available in your visitor space, under "My favorites". You must be logged in to save listings. Your favorites are kept indefinitely until you remove them yourself.
FaqItems.q8Q: How do I report a fraudulent or suspicious listing?
FaqItems.q8A: If you suspect a fraudulent listing (request for a transfer before a visit, abnormally low price, photos that look copied from another site…), contact our team via the "Contact" page form (subject "Report fraud") or by phone/WhatsApp. We handle every report within 24h and immediately remove confirmed fraudulent listings. Never send money without having physically visited the home.
FaqItems.q9Q: How many listings can I publish as an owner?
FaqItems.q9A: During our launch offer, you can publish as many listings as you like, at no cost. Our plans (Single listing, Individual, Independent agent, Agency — see our Pricing page) define the volumes each profile will have once billing is in place; you'll be notified individually before any change. Whether you have one apartment or a portfolio of several properties, our owner dashboard adapts to your needs, with centralized statistics and messaging.
FaqItems.q10Q: How do I edit or delete my account?
FaqItems.q10A: You can edit your personal information from your dashboard's "Settings". To permanently delete your account, contact our support via the "Contact" page (or by phone/WhatsApp) with your registration email address. Deletion is processed within 72 hours and results in the removal of all your data and listings.

faq.endQ: What happens when the launch offer ends?
faq.endA: Publishing stays free for as long as the launch is ongoing. If this changes, every user will be notified individually before any billing is put in place, with a reasonable notice period, and nothing will be charged without prior notice.
